listing.risk.hiddenCharacters.comment: Risk label for an archive or folder entry whose name contains unexpected invisible characters. This does not mean a dot-prefixed hidden file. Never interpolate the name or hidden payload. Draft translations pending native-speaker review.
listing.risk.hiddenCharacters.ha: Haruffan da aka ɓoye a suna

finding.listing.hiddenCharacters.comment: Safety finding counting distinct listed archive or folder entries with unexpected invisible characters in their names, once per entry. The count is not the number of characters. This does not refer to dot-prefixed hidden files. %2$@ is the locale-formatted entry count. No names or decoded payload appear here. Draft translations pending native-speaker review.
